body:
Accepted complete affirmative mathematical deduction for Austrin's exact two-polynomial Boolean-cube question, OWR9/2025 printedp445 (30006210 / OWR-14299088-012).

Published preprint: **[10.5281/zenodo.23443301](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23443301)**. [Zenodo record and downloads](https://zenodo.org/records/23443301) contain the four-page note and source/verification archive. Alec Kriebel, ORCID0009-0001-9320-500X; version1.0.0,17October2026; CC BY4.0.

For all positive n,d and nonzero REAL multilinear f,g of degree at mostd on the UNIFORM sign cube, every full-norm relative coordinate influence at most1/(4096d^8) guarantees some vertex where f*g is nonzero. Disjoint supports force maximum relative influence at least1/(1024d^8). The full squared Fourier norm includes constants, and common zeros are allowed. No optimality or general distribution/other-group/approximate-support extension is asserted. Root and three distinct mathematical families reconstructed the original target and full universal proof; all ten original source artifacts remain unchanged.

The operative note explicitly credits Li-Li-Li-Liu2026 Lemma3.5 for the disjoint-support separator, extracting depth16d^4, and O'Donnell-Saks-Schramm-Servedio2005 section3.3 Eq(6) for the exact arbitrary-real covariance inequality. Classical Markov and the Kothari-et-al. Bernoulli presentation are credited. Neither generic separator nor covariance theorem is new here; the complete normalized-square-density target application is supplied. The old non-strict exponential endpoint is corrected by the degree-one1±x example; the new inclusive threshold has slack.

**Priority limits:** Three bounded primary approaches plus root checking found no earlier recorded complete target-specific deduction in inspected bodies, but do not certify novelty, first discovery/publication or current global openness. The full ePrint2022/218 and full2023/570 followup were inaccessible; the official CRYPTO2022 conference body was read and separately pinned. Exact body/version and procedural-independence limits are disclosed. Prior ingredients alone are distinguished from an earlier recorded full-target solution. [Full priority decision](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/f77e7b9afcfb49261f5a4d676d29c4bf212aa64c/draft_pr_actual_claims_1100_1200_20261017/audits/pr1141_30006210/ROOT_PRIORITY_DECISION.md).

Two successive fresh complete-package adversarial reviews passed the IDENTICAL release with no unresolved issues: [package_01](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/f77e7b9afcfb49261f5a4d676d29c4bf212aa64c/draft_pr_actual_claims_1100_1200_20261017/audits/pr1141_30006210/reviews/package_01/REPORT.md), [package_02](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/f77e7b9afcfb49261f5a4d676d29c4bf212aa64c/draft_pr_actual_claims_1100_1200_20261017/audits/pr1141_30006210/reviews/package_02/REPORT.md). The portable offline runner authenticates all98 frozen authored audit members and ten original inputs. Four exact integer/rational mathematical programs pass ordinary and optimized modes with every mathematical field/type, checker hash and proof hash compared exactly; forty actual incorrect-result subprocesses must fail with expected diagnostics. Only disclosed process/runtime fields are excluded after validation. Source archive rebuilds exactly under the same compression runtime. Finite checks supplement the universal proof and source interfaces, not an arbitrary-dimensional/formal certification. Third-party bodies/excerpts and copied source-heading scans are excluded; the distribution-only metadata repair is documented.

AI tools were used extensively in developing, writing, researching, computing, reproducing and adversarially verifying this work. The note and package are **unrefereed**; internal AI reviews are not external human peer review or journal acceptance. No human outreach was prepared or initiated.

Production readback verified the exact reviewed files and supplied metadata under the repository upload tool's strict comparison contract, with any permitted server representation normalization recorded in the receipt. Google Workspace CLI added one DOI row at `'Math Puzzles'!A163:D163` and read it back exactly. Reviewed source head:`b1d6bc6ceb66e9c9c98cfae229ee86e5720799e2`.
